text.tspan: Global air travel capacity and passenger traffic
Available seat-kilometers measure carrying capacity by multiplying every seat on a flight — whether filled or
empty — by the distance flown. Passenger-kilometers measure traffic by multiplying only seats sold to paying
Data source: International Civil Aviation Organization via Airlines for America (2026)
